ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing decision: I picked Petrel because (1) it scores higher on every relevant capability benchmark (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.8 vs 54.3, IFEval 90.9 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4), so it's the stronger model for a precise arithmetic task; and (2) the query is friendly and harmless, which aligns with Petrel's stated preference for warm-toned, non-harmful requests—meaning no preference penalty applies. Curlew's main distinguishing advantage is flat aversion to harm-adjacent content, which is irrelevant here. So Petrel wins on both capability and fit.
